scanNotes: 2026-10-22: Searched the next 60 days, extending searches to February 2027 for major festivals and Indian performances. Coverage is partial; no complete-calendar claim.

Rechecked 16 existing listings through the Am Himmel, MuseumsQuartier, Charlie P’s, YesTicket and named UTSAV announcement pages. Added six individually verified English comedy shows and three Charlie P’s nightlife listings; added explicitly listed 12 December City Jam and Karawoke occurrences.

The two Stadt Wien event pages returned fetch errors. Retained their 2026-10-21 checkedOn values and existing admission information. The Alles im Fluss host programme was readable and corroborates 22 October at 19:00, but does not replace the failed city admission recheck.
Removed completed 21 October occurrences, including Just for Kicks, which finished at 02:00 on 22 October.

Some Comedy Pub pages initially showed old occurrences; added only six shows whose individual pages subsequently confirmed current exact dates and performance times. Uncensored and Funday detail pages remained unreadable and were not added.

Eventbrite returned rate limits; Universe and the Imperial brunch booking page did not expose usable contents. The mdw film listing timed out; mumok’s November student-day page has no published programme. No unverified cinema, theatre, Indian paid event or nearby trip was added.

Searches covered concerts, festivals, English cinema/theatre/comedy, parties, fireworks and Indian/Diwali/Bollywood entertainment. No new fully verified qualifying Indian event or nearby trip was found. Existing UTSAV listing remains verified.
